name: 이평선터치 매매

universe.note: 거래일 16:00 ka00198 당일누적 상위 20 ∪ ka10032 거래대금 상위 30 (중복 제거), 코스피/코스닥만. 매차 최소금액으로 1주 이상. 다음 거래일 관리종목(MTS01)·관심 USE_TRADE=Y. 매일 전량 교체, 원장 미청산 유지. 기존 관심은 현재가>SMA20 유지, 이틀 연속 음봉+종가≤SMA20 일 때만 제외(하루 이탈은 유예). 신규 편입은 현재가>SMA20. 양봉 필터 없음. 장중 신규 편입 없음.

rules.entry: from above touch SMA20 once; do not buy on touch; same-day only: wait for a 3-min bar that closes bullish above SMA20 (close>open and close>SMA20); place a limit buy at the SMA20 nearby tick; if unfilled after 10 minutes cancel remainder (no market follow-up); wait expires same day; retouch resets; 14:00 cutoff only if next calendar day is closed; after full exit ban rebuy that stock same day
rules.halfTp: pnl>=tp1Pct sell tp1QtyRatio LIMIT at trigger (10m cancel+rearm); BE/flatten 0% only after tp1 fully filled; then pnl>=tp1Pct sell tp1QtyRatio (1.4%/50%); then pnl>=tp2Pct sell tp2QtyRatio of remaining (4%/50%); tp3/tp4 disabled; residual trail peak>=4 then -3%p; from 15:15 if 0%<=pnl<=4% flatten; if qty==1, any reached TP1/TP2 step flattens 100%
rules.afterHalf: after 1st/2nd TP, remaining flattens at avg -afterHalfStopPct (0=breakeven); residual trail when peak>=afterHalfTrailMinPct and pnl<=peak-afterHalfTrailTpPct (also when tp3 disabled and qty>=2); else +tp4Pct flatten if enabled
rules.stop: before any TP: hard -2%; after 1st or 2nd TP: avg 0% (breakeven) flatten remaining; same-day entry flatten after 15:18 if px<=avg; prior-day SMA20 after 15:18 | weak MFE flat: hold>=weakHoldMin, never reached current tp1Pct (tp1Taken or maxPnl>=tp1Pct), maxPnl<weakPeakMaxPct, pnl<=weakExitMaxPnlPct
rules.takeProfit: intraday: 1st +1.4% sell 50%; 2nd +4% sell 50% of remaining; no 3rd/4th; residual trail 4/-3; 15:15 flat 0~4%; qty=1 flattens at TP1/TP2
